module.name: panels
module.title: Resizable panels
module.description: Stacked panels by default; on a wide screen a split with keyboard-operable role=separator handles carrying bounded aria-valuenow.

ui.name: panel-group
ui.guidance: The fallback is stacked, full-width panels: with no JavaScript the content is simply laid out one after another, which is also what a narrow screen gets. Resizing is an enhancement on a layout that already works, never the thing that makes the content reachable.
ui.keyboard: The handle is a focusable role="separator": arrow keys move the split by one percent, PageUp/PageDown by ten, and Home/End jump to its bounds.

ui.name: panel-handle
ui.summary: Renders the divider between two panels.
ui.guidance: It is a focusable role="separator" with bounded aria-valuenow, which is what makes the split adjustable by keyboard. A bare styled div would be a pointer-only control, and a separator without the values reports a position of nothing.
ui.keyboard: The handle is a focusable role="separator": arrow keys move the split by one percent, PageUp/PageDown by ten, and Home/End jump to its bounds.
